notes: Vemoa is Hungarian-first: a message whose language is not given (or not hu|en) is sent as hu — a per-app fallback, unlike apps that fall back to en.
A key is the name as the code emits it (underscores or hyphens): the wire name is vemoa-<key>-<locale>.
Variables are scalars. `*_label` and `amount` are ready-made words in the message language; the raw code/amount_minor stay for conditions.

Do not use ventMail-reserved names for variables (unsubscribe_url, preferences_url, browser_url, recipient_email, current_year): ventMail overwrites them. Vemoa's own opt-out link is optout_url; ventMail's List-Unsubscribe still works and arrives as the unsubscribed webhook.
Transactional mail is sent with o:tracking=no; the unsubscribe links are /unsubscribe/... so a rewriting tracker leaves them alone.

Marketing keys (rebook_nudge, birthday_greeting, win_back, fill_offer, favorite_deal) go on the marketing channel, closed until ventMail opens it; review_request stays transactional with an opt-out (owner/DPO question open).

Redesign 2026 (docs/design/email-templates): a designed template's dotted name (booking.time) is sent with underscores (booking_time) — ventMail reads a dot as nesting, and t:variables are flat scalars. `design` names the designed template a key stands for; `design_pending` the variables that wait for a backlog item.

BL-25: a `design` that is not a Figma design (docs/design/email-templates/manifest.json) is written by docs/design/email-templates/export_ventmail.py in the family's blocks (BL-39, BL-40, BL-44); docs/design/email-templates/ventmail/ holds the export of every key — the files ventMail imports (resources/mail-templates/vemoa, `ventmail:templates:import <workspace> vemoa`).

subject.en: A decision about your review ({{ notice_ref }})

templates.purpose: 2026-10-22 (GDPR art. 12–13): a new version of Vemoa's privacy notice was published — what changes, from when, where to read it. To every guest with a Vemoa account and an address on file, once per version and guest, from the platform's own outbox (platform_mail_outbox). The guest also finds it in the notification centre. Held back (VEMOA_MAIL_PENDING_TEMPLATES) until imported.

variables.document_effective_from: string — the day it takes effect, in words ('november 8., vasárnap')
variables.document_change_summary: string — what changes, in the admin's words
variables.links_document: string — the new version on vemoa.app (https://vemoa.app/adatvedelem?version=2)
variables.support_email: string — where to write with a question (VEMOA_SUPPORT_EMAIL)

subject.hu: Változik a Vemoa adatkezelési tájékoztatója — {{ document_effective_from }}

templates.purpose: 2026-10-22: a message someone sent on the vemoa.app/kapcsolat contact form, to Vemoa's support mailbox (vemoa.support_email) — always in Hungarian (the team's language; the sender's page language is a variable). Sent from the platform's own outbox (platform_mail_outbox): the sender's name, address and words are wiped once delivered, nothing else keeps them. Reply-To is the sender's address (MailTemplates::REPLY_TO). No copy goes to the sender (the form would otherwise send mail to any address). Held back (VEMOA_MAIL_PENDING_TEMPLATES) until imported: until then the page shows the support address instead of the form.

variables.message_ref: string — the message's short reference (8 characters), the one the sender saw on the page
variables.sender_name: string — the name the sender gave
variables.sender_email: string — the address the sender gave (also the Reply-To)
variables.topic: string — code: guest | provider | partnership | other
variables.topic_label: string — the topic in words ('Vendégként kérdezek')
variables.message_text: string — the message as written (plain text, line breaks kept; up to 4000 characters)
variables.sender_locale_label: string — the language of the page it was sent from, in words ('magyar', 'angol'): the language to answer in
variables.sent_at_label: string — when it was sent, in words ('október 22., csütörtök 14:05')
variables.links_reply: string — mailto: the sender's address, the answer button

templates.purpose: M3.4 (provider terms 10a): the workspace's paid Vemoa plan ended because ventPay could not collect its renewal (ventPay's dunning ran out: the entitlement went from full access to unpaid) — the workspace now runs on Free, its data stays. Not sent when the owner cancelled. To every owner's own address, once per ventPay entitlement version and owner.

variables.provider_the_name: string — the name with its article ('a Rózsa Stúdió', 'az Ilona Stúdió')
variables.provider_the_name_cap: string — the same at a sentence's start ('A …', 'Az …')
variables.links_billing: string — https://biz.vemoa.app/settings/billing (the plan, buying it again, ventPay's invoices)

subject.hu: Véget ért a {{ plan_name }} csomagod — {{ provider_name }}
subject.en: Your {{ plan_name }} plan has ended — {{ provider_name }}

templates.purpose: BL-74: a provider the guest favourited published a new deal (its own discount — not an ad, rule 9). Marketing: only to a guest who switched it on (notify.email.favorites_deals, off by default), from the guests' own outbox (platform context, never a provider's); the address is read at sending. Once per deal and guest (notify:favorite_deal:{deal}:{guest}), at most one a day per guest and one a week per guest and provider. The opt-out link and ventMail's unsubscribe turn the switch off. Held back (VEMOA_MAIL_PENDING_TEMPLATES) until imported.

variables.provider_the_name_cap: string — the name with its article at a sentence's start ('A Rózsa Stúdió', 'Az Ilona Stúdió')
variables.deal_label: string — the deal's label as guests see it on the provider's card ('−20%')
variables.deal_service: string — the service it is for ('' when it is for every service)
variables.deal_price: string — the price with the deal, formatted ('7 920 Ft'; '' without a fixed price)
variables.deal_list_price: string — the price before it, formatted ('9 900 Ft'; '' without a fixed price)
variables.deal_when: string — when it can be taken, in words ('október 18., szombat 9:00' or '9:00–12:00'; '' when any time)
variables.links_provider_page: string — the provider's page on vemoa.app (https://vemoa.app/szolgaltato/rozsa-studio), where the deal is booked
variables.links_unsubscribe: string — Vemoa's signed one-click opt-out (/unsubscribe/guest/…): turns the guest's favourite-deal e-mails off. NOT ventMail's reserved unsubscribe_url
